name: Adient plc
summary:
Adient plc (ADNT) reported earnings of $0.52 per share on revenue of $3.87 billion for the fiscal second quarter ended March 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.37 per share on revenue of $3.57 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.41 per share. The company beat expectations by 26.83% while revenue grew 7.03% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2026 revenue of approximately $14.80 billion. The company's previous guidance was revenue of approximately $14.6 billion, and the current consensus revenue estimate is $14.58 billion for the year ending September 30, 2026.

Adient is a global leader in automotive seating. With approximately 77,000 employees in 32 countries, Adient operates 202 manufacturing/assembly plants worldwide.
subject: Adient plc Beat Expectations
